correctness.rationale: The exact population recurrence m_i(t+1)=m_i(t)(1-a_{i+1})+m_{i-1}a_i makes deficient colors permanently deficient. Maximal consecutive active runs lose precisely their left endpoint at each update; a deficient predecessor packet of positive size causes exactly one final move. This proves statewise first-entry and period, sharp constructions, full EGF census, extremal coefficient and asymptotic. Direct vertex-level exhaustive simulation checked 1,376,046 states for q=3..6, theta=1..3, n=2..7; independent population and signature-binomial counts agreed for 260 triples q=3..7, theta=1..4, n=2..14. Computation does not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The natural cyclic-contact process on cliques is a basic exact solvable benchmark for excitable graph dynamics. The uniform theorem supplies a full statewise transient clock, exact complete initial-state population enumerators for every q, theta and n, the sharp universal relaxation bound, and a genuine phase discontinuity between contact thresholds one and at least two. It generalizes previous separate parameter slices and gives an explicit rare-defect conditional concentration law, not an arbitrary small-n recomputation.
